title: Design: Credit Terms dropdown on New Customer looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses Due on Receipt as the default, and you compare the New Customer term dropdown with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p5-03-new-customer-the-credit-terms-picker.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: a list as wide as the box opens: text-only rows, COD first, then "Due on Receipt" highlighted light blue with blue text and a light-blue "Default" pill after it, then the other active terms in the page's order; no row shows a hover text (as in ct-p5-03-new-customer-the-credit-terms-picker.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R3: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Customer and Edit Customer lists the shop's active terms in the S1-R5 order. The default carries a "Default" tag after its name.”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer: the Credit Terms picker"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p5-03-new-customer-the-credit-terms-picker.png

The design's own words:

  • “No hover hints on the options, as in the build (r11-01).”
  • “Source: DS Menus, text-only rows, selected row tinted; DS Badge for the tag.”
